_notes: Machine error codes the Dashboard API can return. The canonical table is apps/dashboard/src/lib/server/api/errors.ts; scripts/check-openapi-drift.mjs asserts this file lists exactly the codes that module can emit, so the published reference cannot drift from the running server. Add a code in errors.ts first, then here.

codes.meaning: The request was malformed or a field failed validation. Read details, correct the request, do not retry unchanged.
No credential was presented, or the one presented was not accepted. Obtain or refresh a credential; retrying the same one will fail identically.
The account's billing state blocks this operation.
The credential is valid but not permitted this operation, usually a scope or ownership boundary. Do not retry; a different credential is needed.
The addressed resource does not exist, or is not visible to this credential.
No API route matches this path at all. Check /api/openapi.json for the routes this deployment serves.
The route exists but not for this HTTP verb. details carries allowed_methods, and the Allow header repeats it.
The operation conflicts with current state, for example a stale version or an operation already in progress. Re-read state before deciding.
The resource existed and has been removed permanently.
The request body exceeded the accepted size.
The Content-Type is not accepted by this route.
The request parsed but could not be acted on as given.
Too many requests. Wait retry_after_seconds, or the Retry-After header, before retrying.
Legacy code from the retired Free/Pro split, kept because old clients may still branch on it. Nothing in the API is tier-gated as of August 2026.
An unexpected server fault. Safe to retry with backoff; report request_id if it persists.
A dependency failed. Retry with backoff.
The service is temporarily unable to handle the request. Retry with backoff.
A dependency did not answer in time. Retry with backoff.
Fallback for a 4xx status with no more specific code. Treat as non-retryable and read message.
